+title: Resume restores all recorded nested sub-agent sessions with their parent, not only the root
+---
+## What
+`session/resume` must resume the whole tree of nested sessions, not only the root session. This is a rule from the user (2026-11-03): Claude Code does not resume sub-agent sessions, and that is not acceptable here.
+
+Today (checked in the code, not run): `RoutedACPAgent.resumeSession` -> `restoreRecordedSession` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/SessionResume.swift`, near line 387) calls `restoreSessionWithHostChecks(id:)` (`SessionSetup.swift` near line 1191) for ONE session. The Router restores the transcript tree under it, whose children are FORKS (parent = enclosing folder, `TranscriptTree.parentId`). A sub-agent recording lives flat in `<recordingsDir>/<routerId>/<id>` and is a separate root whose record has `agentSpawn.parentSessionId`. So the sub-agent sessions are not restored.
+
+Do:
+1. After the root is restored, find its recorded sub-agent sessions through `agentSpawn.parentSessionId`, at every depth (children of children). Use the recorded session listing of the Router (`RecordedSessions.swift` gives `kind: .subagent` and `parentID`); do not scan folders by hand.
+2. Restore each one with the same call as a root (`restoreSessionWithHostChecks`), parent before child, and register each as an ordinary session with the shared session build from the first task (own ACP `SessionId`, `parentSessionId`, projector, ledger, history sink). Keep the child ACP id stable: the same Router ULID gives the same ACP id.
+3. Send the replay of the tree as in the replay task (`awnkj0k`): `subagent_update` for the chain parent first, then the child history under the child id. No child traffic before its announcement.
+4. A child that cannot be restored (missing tool, model mismatch, record unreadable) must not fail the resume of the root. Keep it out of the tree, log it, and report it (see the client card for the observable state of this).
+5. Tools: a recording holds tool names, not instances. A child uses the tool roster that its definition selects (`tools`, `disallowedTools` of the agent). Check `restoreSessionWithHostChecks` reports for each child (`logRestoreReports`).
+6. Open question (write the answer in a task comment, discuss with the user before any card on FoundationModelsAgents): the `AgentRunner` of FoundationModelsAgents keeps the runs. Can a restored child session be adopted as a run, so `check agent`, `send agent` and `cancel agent` work on it? The RFD says a child is reusable and idle does not end it. If the runner cannot adopt it, the restored child is visible and replayed but the parent model cannot give it new work.
+
+The Router also may need a card (restore a parent with its sub-agent subtree in one call). Decide in a task comment if step 1 and 2 are enough with the existing public API, or write down the gap. Do NOT change the Router or FoundationModelsAgents from this task.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] After a resume of a root that had a nested run (depth 3), `sessions` holds an entry for the root, the child and the grandchild, each with its parent.
+- [ ] The ACP ids of the children are the same after a second resume.
+- [ ] The replay sends the chain parent first and no child event before its `subagent_update`.
+- [ ] A child that fails to restore does not fail the root, and it is not in `children`.
+- [ ] A resume of a child id directly is refused (the child restrictions task).
+- [ ] `session/close` of the root closes the restored children.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/ResumeNestedSessionsTests.swift`: record a session with a depth 3 nested run with the stub model, resume, check entries, parents, stable ids, replay order, a failing child, close.
+- [ ] An integration test in `IntegrationTests` with the real `acp-agent` binary: resume over the wire and read the order of the messages.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter ResumeNestedSessionsTests`. All pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #subagents
\ No newline at end of file
